name: geometrydash-poki2
description: Static template for Geometry Dash unblocked — build scripts and sitemap generation

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && npx html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-js true --minify-css true game-template.html -o dist/index.html && cp -R data dist/data || true && cp -R assets dist/assets || true && node scripts/generate-pages.js && node scripts/gen-sitemap.js
